plugins.name: Armory
plugins.description: Star farming for the Armory: one list of accounts and the games they farm XP with (battles, jackpot, upgrade, Guess the Rank, blackjack, crash, dice and plinko (by the Games plugin when it is on, otherwise by the Armory itself)). Keeps every pass going. Credits are spent by hand in the Armory shop tab. Starts off, in practice mode.

plugins.name: Converter
plugins.description: Turns what accounts earn into tokens, in steps you choose: sell clicked cases, sell cheap skins, buy capsules with the cash, open them with every drop sold to tokens, upgrade the tokens into Dragon Lores. Starts in practice mode.

plugins.name: Effects
plugins.description: Manages the site's special effects with ammo: pick effects, then buy, sell, start or queue them on all accounts at once or one account. The queue starts each effect as soon as nothing of its kind is running, and can buy it with ammo first.

plugins.name: Games
plugins.description: Plays the games tab for its rewards: the smallest bets that reach each game's next reward tier, only when the reward is worth more than the bets are expected to lose. Tracks bets, wins, rewards and the profit. Starts in practice mode.

plugins.name: Missions
plugins.description: Claims finished missions on every clicking account and shows mission progress.

plugins.name: Opener
plugins.description: A tool for opening cases, capsules or collections on the accounts you choose: Practice run shows what it would do, Open now buys a set amount (or what the spare cash covers, or uses what is in stock), opens it all and keeps or sells the drops. Tracks XP and rank-ups.

plugins.name: Monthly pass
plugins.description: Claims ready monthly pass tiers on the accounts you choose — the free track, the Pro track or both.

plugins.name: Proxy manager
plugins.description: Runs accounts through your own proxies or WireGuard configs, 20 per exit IP (the site's limit), so one install can click more than 20. Paste proxies (HTTP with or without user:pass, SOCKS5 without) or WireGuard configs, test them, and pin accounts to one if you like; the rest are spread by themselves.

plugins.name: Rewards
plugins.description: Claims ready /rewards tiers (rank, clicks, vault, inventory value and the rest) on the accounts you choose.

plugins.name: Skillmaps
plugins.description: A tool for setting up accounts' skills: pick the accounts and a preset, then Apply. Each skill costs its price plus a skill point (3 a rank, 54 by Global Elite).

plugins.name: Skin themes
plugins.description: Styles the whole panel after a CS2 skin: its colours, fonts and small details. Turn it on in Settings > Theme and pick a look there.

plugins.name: Trader
plugins.description: Moves tokens and items between your accounts: one trade at a time, or by trade routes you set up (from which accounts, to which account, and what goes: tokens, terminals, skins over a price or by name). Both sides must be accounts in this app and clicking. Starts in practice mode.
